## About
EuroCraft started as a remodeling company. When founder Paul Kraft bought his first house and needed a new roof, he found that most construction companies provided fairly poor service. He thought customers deserved better information and someone who would take the time to help them understand the process.
That is still how we work. We visit your property, listen to your concerns and your design preferences, and give you a clear quote with no hidden fees. Our crew is punctual and leaves your property clean when the job is done.
We are based right here in Austin and rated 5 on Google from 42 reviews. Give Paul a call and we'll talk through what your home needs.

## Services
- Metal Roofing: We know standing seam metal roofing inside and out. A double locked 24 gauge standing seam metal roof holds up better than snap lock and R-panel metal roofing.
- Shingle Roofing: A selection of the best shingles in the industry, from architectural shingles to wind resistant and hail resistant options.
- Windows: Premium windows from single hung and sliding to casement, awning and custom shapes. Energy efficient windows with argon gas and low E coating cut your monthly electricity bill.
- Siding: James Hardie fiber cement siding, installed to the required installation guidelines. We paint your siding once it's up, or you can choose Color Plus with baked on paint.

## FAQ
Q: How does a project get started?
A: Every project begins with a free inspection. We visit your property, understand your concerns and listen to your design preferences, then give you a competitive estimate.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Along with your estimate, we can go over financing options if you need them.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: One reviewer said Paul understood the issues their insurance adjuster described and worked with the insurance company on their roof. Call us and we'll talk through your situation.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Our team is licensed, insured and safety-conscious, so you're protected from start to finish.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We work with homeowners and businesses throughout Austin.

Other quotes I received were four pages long, filled with legal language that seemed to shift responsibility away from the contractor for things like property damage. Eurocraft’s simplicity and transparency really stood out.

The project was completed within a single day, just as they said it would be, with no surprises along the way. Everything was handled professionally, efficiently, and with great attention to detail.

What really impressed me was their honesty. When we discussed siding, the team lead told me my siding was actually in great shape and didn’t need to be replaced. Instead, he recommended a simple trip to Lowe’s for exterior caulk and even explained how to properly apply it myself. You can’t put a price on that kind of genuine honesty and kindness.

If you’re looking for a reliable and trustworthy roofing company, Eurocraft Exteriors is an excellent choice." (David Goodman, 5/5)
